title: Winter Break Daily Art Camp (Dec 29) - Ages 4-7
summary: Winter Break Daily Art Camp (Dec 29) - Ages 4-7
description: Register Here Starting August 11! Registration for all Aurora Cultural Centre programs is on the Town of Aurora’s e-PLAY website. All programs continue to be part of the Aurora Cultural Centre. Monday December 29, 2025 9:00 – 4:30 pm | Ages 4-7 Aurora Town Square – Shining Hill Visual Arts Studio A 50 Victoria Street, Aurora Kick off winter break with a fun-filled day of creativity! Young artists will explore various tools and materials through hands-on projects in painting, printmaking, sculpting, and mixed media. This special one-day camp is the perfect way to start the holiday season while making new friends. All materials are provided, plus a free Aurora Cultural Centre Artist T-Shirt for messy fun!
